commit.message: [ui][android] Fix MenuView opening detached above a bottom anchor (#51412) Fixes - https://github.com/expo/expo/issues/51392 On Android, the community `MenuView` opens well above its anchor when the anchor is near the bottom of the screen. This is a Compose bug, not an expo-ui one. Plain Compose repro: https://github.com/intergalacticspacehighway/compose-dropdownmenu-edge-to-edge-repro - Compose `Popup` (`AndroidPopup.android.kt`, `updatePosition()`) passes the width and height of `getWindowVisibleDisplayFrame` as `windowSize` and drops its status bar offset. The anchor comes from `positionInWindow()`, which in an edge-to-edge window starts at the top of the screen. So the window bottom that the menu sees is too high by the status bar height. - Material3 `DropdownMenuPositionProvider` only accepts a position with `y + menuHeight <= windowSize.height - 48dp`. For an anchor near the bottom, "above the anchor" fails this check and the menu is pinned to the window edge, away from the anchor. - With `PopupProperties(clippingEnabled = false)`, `windowSize` comes from the full window bounds, which matches the anchor's coordinates. Compose's KDoc for `clippingEnabled` says: "Setting this to false will allow windows to be accurately positioned." - Still present in the latest `material3 1.5.0-beta01` / `ui 1.12.0`, and the source is unchanged in `ui 1.13.0-beta01`. Changes: - Jetpack Compose `DropdownMenu`: new `properties` prop (`PopupProperties`: `focusable`, `dismissOnBackPress`, `dismissOnClickOutside`, `clippingEnabled`), passed to Material3 `DropdownMenu`. Defaults match Material3, so existing `DropdownMenu` behavior does not change. - Community `MenuView` passes `{ clippingEnabled: false }`. Plain Compose repro (no React Native), Medium Phone emulator, API 37.1, 1080x2400, edge-to-edge, `material3 1.5.0-alpha17` (same as `@expo/ui`). Bounds in px from `positionOnScreen()` / `getLocationOnScreen()`: | Anchor | `clippingEnabled` | Anchor | Menu | Gap | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | bottom | `true` (default) | 2182..2253 | 1665..2085 | **97px** | | bottom | `false` | 2182..2253 | 1762..2182 | 0 | | 100dp above bottom | either | 1919..1990 | 1499..1919 | 0 | | middle | either | 1133..1204 | 1204..1624 | 0 | Same result on `material3 1.5.0-beta01`. | `clippingEnabled = true` | `clippingEnabled = false` | | :--: | :--: | | | | - `./gradlew :expo-ui:compileDebugKotlin` in bare-expo passes. - oxlint and oxfmt pass on the changed TS files; `tsc -p packages/expo-ui` reports no errors in `@expo/ui`. - Not yet run: this branch in bare-expo on a device. - [x] I added a `changeset` for user-facing changes to published packages (see [.changeset/README.md](https://github.com/expo/expo/blob/main/.changeset/README.md)). - [x] This diff will work correctly for `npx expo prebuild` & EAS Build (eg: updated a module plugin). - [ ] Conforms with the [Documentation Writing Style Guide](https://github.com/expo/expo/blob/main/guides/Expo%20Documentation%20Writing%20Style%20Guide.md) (cherry picked from commit 8d5bef561384475b61fb0e2a781b25ef54df47be)
